design.phase_b_description: Estimate detector performance on 9 held-out test tasks (Folds 01-09, 3 seeds each = 27 evaluations) using frozen checkpoints, frozen runtime parameters, and frozen metric definitions. No threshold tuning, no model retraining, no post-hoc metric selection.
design.fold_00_role: PILOT_DIAGNOSTIC — reported separately, not pooled with confirmatory folds
design.no_pass_fail_rationale: Phase B is a confirmatory estimation of frozen-model performance. No pre-hoc pass/fail cutoff was registered in the original protocol. Reporting confidence intervals and descriptive statistics only. Any deployment-readiness judgment must be made separately and must not be based on post-hoc threshold selection.

metric_1.name: K10_containment
metric_1.definition: Fraction of teacher-positive emitted episodes where emit_step ∈ corridor_active_at_t (valid-start set membership). Equivalent to CW / teacher_positive_episodes under LOTO_METRIC_SCHEMA_V2.
metric_1.rationale: Measures whether the detector's first emission falls within a valid K10 corridor start. This is the core deployment claim: the detector identifies a legitimate intervention opportunity.
metric_1.reporting: per-seed, per-fold mean ± std, confirmatory macro average, confirmatory micro average (pooled episodes), 95% bootstrap CI

metric_2.name: no_corridor_frame_FPR
metric_2.definition: DEFINITION A — PER-FRAME SCORE FPR. Fraction of all evaluable no-corridor frames (step_idx NOT IN corridor_active_at_t valid-start set) where the raw detector corridor_p > tau_corridor (0.3). Computed over every frame that has a corridor_p value, independent of whether the state machine emitted on that episode. This is a per-frame score discrimination metric, NOT an emission-based trigger rate.
metric_2.numerator: Count of no-corridor frames where corridor_p > tau_corridor
metric_2.denominator: Count of all evaluable no-corridor frames (step_idx ∉ corridor_active_at_t) with a corridor_p value
metric_2.distinction_from_episode_metric: This frame-level FPR is distinct from episode_false_trigger_rate (FPn / n_negative), which counts teacher-negative episodes where the state machine emitted. A detector can have low frame FPR (most frames below tau) but high episode false-trigger rate (tau exceeded on a few frames per episode, enough for the guard mechanism to trigger emission). Both metrics are reported; they measure different aspects of specificity.
metric_2.rationale: Measures the detector's raw score discrimination: how often does corridor_p exceed tau on frames where no corridor exists? Low frame FPR is necessary but not sufficient for selectivity — the episode false-trigger rate captures whether those false-positive frames cluster enough to trigger emission.
metric_2.reporting: per-seed, per-fold mean ± std, confirmatory macro average, confirmatory micro average (pooled frames), 95% bootstrap CI. Numerator and denominator reported explicitly alongside the ratio.

coverage.name: coverage
coverage.definition: Fraction of teacher-positive episodes where detector emits (regardless of timing correctness). TP_emitted / teacher_positive_episodes.
coverage.rationale: Upper bound on recall. If coverage is low, the detector misses too many opportunities for any downstream attack to be meaningful.

median_signed_timing_error.name: median_signed_timing_error
median_signed_timing_error.definition: Median of (emit_step − teacher_anchor) over teacher-positive emitted episodes. teacher_anchor = first stable_carry step + guard=5. Positive = late, negative = early.

median_absolute_timing_error.name: median_absolute_timing_error
median_absolute_timing_error.definition: Median of |emit_step − teacher_anchor| over teacher-positive emitted episodes.

early_trigger_rate.name: early_trigger_rate
early_trigger_rate.definition: Fraction of teacher-positive emitted episodes where emit_step < min(corridor_active_at_t). FE / teacher_positive_episodes.
early_trigger_rate.rationale: Early triggers may be usable if still within valid approach window, but indicate detector impatience.

late_trigger_rate.name: late_trigger_rate
late_trigger_rate.definition: Fraction of teacher-positive emitted episodes where emit_step > max(corridor_active_at_t). Subset of LI under LOTO_METRIC_SCHEMA_V2.
late_trigger_rate.rationale: Late triggers miss the corridor entirely and are equivalent to false positives for attack purposes.

episode_false_trigger_rate.name: episode_false_trigger_rate
episode_false_trigger_rate.definition: Fraction of teacher-negative episodes (no corridor) where detector emits. FPn / teacher_negative_episodes.
episode_false_trigger_rate.rationale: Episode-level complement to frame-level FPR. A single false-triggered episode may cause an unnecessary intervention.

zero_emission_rate.name: zero_emission_rate
zero_emission_rate.definition: Fraction of all 50 held-out episodes where detector never emits. Includes both teacher-positive and teacher-negative episodes.
zero_emission_rate.rationale: If zero-emission rate is high, the detector is too conservative to be useful.

score_saturation.name: score_saturation
score_saturation.definition: Fraction of all frames where corridor_p >= 0.99. Reported separately for corridor-positive and corridor-negative frames.
score_saturation.rationale: Near-1.0 scores indicate the model cannot discriminate — it outputs ceiling values regardless of input. This is a functional failure mode.

corridor_p_quantiles.name: corridor_p_quantiles
corridor_p_quantiles.definition: p01, p05, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99, p99.9 of corridor_p over all frames, split by corridor label.
corridor_p_quantiles.rationale: Full score distribution for assessing discrimination quality.

aggregation.per_seed: Each seed's metrics computed independently on its 50 held-out episodes.
aggregation.per_fold: Mean ± std of 3 seeds within each fold.

confirmatory_macro_average.definition: Mean of 9 fold-level means. Each fold weighted equally regardless of episode count.
confirmatory_macro_average.ci_method: Bootstrap: sample 9 folds with replacement, compute mean of fold means, 10000 resamples, 95% percentile CI.

confirmatory_micro_average.definition: Pool all 450 confirmatory episodes, compute metric once over pooled data.
confirmatory_micro_average.ci_method: Bootstrap: sample 450 episodes with replacement, compute metric, 10000 resamples, 95% percentile CI.

fold_variability.definition: Std of 9 fold-level means. Reports best fold, worst fold (by each primary metric).

aggregation.pilot_separate: Fold 00 reported in a separate table row labeled PILOT_DIAGNOSTIC. Never pooled with confirmatory folds.

edge_case_handling.invalid_episode: Defined as: missing privileged records, step discontinuity, or teacher label generation failure. Counted and reported. Excluded from all metric denominators. If >5% of held-out episodes are invalid, flag as P1 data quality issue.
edge_case_handling.zero_positive_episodes: If a fold/seed has 0 teacher-positive episodes (no corridor), coverage, K10 containment, and timing metrics are undefined. Report as 'NO_POSITIVES' and exclude from aggregation of those metrics. FPR and score distribution are still computable.
edge_case_handling.zero_emission_seed: If a seed emits on 0 episodes: coverage=0, K10=undefined (report as 'NO_EMISSION'), FPR=0 (by definition, since no false positive frames exist if model never exceeds tau). Flag as score saturation suspect.
edge_case_handling.score_saturation_handling: If any seed shows corridor_p >= 0.99 on >90% of frames, flag in report. Do NOT exclude from aggregation — report with flag.

confirmatory_table.rows: 9 folds × 3 seeds = 27 rows, plus fold-level mean/std rows, plus confirmatory macro/micro summary rows
confirmatory_table.columns: fold, seed, test_task, n_heldout, n_positive, n_negative, n_emitted, coverage, K10_containment, median_signed_error, median_absolute_error, early_rate, late_rate, no_corridor_frame_fpr, episode_false_trigger_rate, zero_emission_rate, score_saturation_pos, score_saturation_neg, corridor_p_median_pos, corridor_p_median_neg

reporting_template.pilot_table: Same columns, single row for Fold 00 pilot aggregate (mean of 3 seeds). Labeled PILOT_DIAGNOSTIC.
reporting_template.full_table: All 10 folds displayed, Fold 00 clearly marked as PILOT, Folds 01-09 as CONFIRMATORY.

prohibited_post_hoc_actions: Selecting the 'best' metric after seeing results
Changing primary metric definition after seeing results
Excluding folds or seeds based on performance
Re-running with different tau values and reporting the best
Pooling Fold 00 with confirmatory folds for primary conclusion
Claiming 'deployment-ready' based solely on confirmatory estimation without separate deployment qualification
